---
title: "About Field Notes"
---

This is a fictional publication and a working multi-page website example.
Its pages do not execute Python or R.

## Where things live

| File | Purpose |
|:-----|:--------|
| `_quarto.yml` | Website configuration, navigation, search, and theme |
| `index.qmd` | Home page |
| `posts.qmd` | Automatically generated article listing |
| `posts/*/index.qmd` | Individual articles with dates and categories |
| `styles.css` | Small visual customizations |

To preview a complete website, render or preview the project directory rather
than only a single page. Search indexes the rendered pages.
